checkpoint_selection: previously frozen final.pt only; diagnostic never selects weights

velocity_probe.states: exact per-object teacher bridge at all k=0,...,31, normalized chord directions
velocity_probe.conditions: original proxy256 features; teacher-conditioned query direction/time
velocity_probe.targets: same discrete bridge targets as training, double computation then float32
velocity_probe.mse: mean over all 32 steps, 258 directions, and 3 coordinates; object counts equal
velocity_probe.comparison: zero vector field, original A, final seed10 and seed11 on identical grid
velocity_probe.warning: Teacher-conditioned states differ from free rollout; MSE is not deployment success.

endpoint_probe: saved raw deployment directions versus chosen teachers, with Fixed zero-displacement comparator
quality_margin_definition: actual raw triangle angle statistic minus per-object Fixed statistic, in degrees
shortfall_definition: positive Fixed-minus-raw deficit, only objects failing the unchanged 1e-6 degree tolerance
